CIV.note: The RAXIO datacentre is named only as the site of a coming CIVIX point of presence; renting to others is not stated.
Sovereignty is mentioned only in general terms; no state data rule, hosting or contract terms.

facts.fact: ARTCI says Akamai was integrated into the CIVIX exchange point, in service since October 2013, and that Netflix and PCH now connect there alongside local operators.
ARTCI gives CIVIX average daily traffic of 4 Mbps in 2013, 10 Gbps in 2019, 20 Gbps in 2020-2024 and 36 Gbps in 2025-2026.

CIV.note: No nationally owned data centre for hire or government hosting is stated.
PPDU's selection of CIVIX to become a regional exchange is a plan, with no agreement, works or service stated.
